summary: Iteration 10 — verified the loop-variable-leak fix in POST /api/backups and the new Migration bundle button in Settings. All 16 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_backup_iter10.py pass on the live preview backend. Playwright: /settings renders cleanly (no red React overlay), Backup & Restore card visible, new 'Migration bundle' button (data-testid=backup-migration-bundle) present next to 'Backup now', click triggers POST /api/backups followed by GET /api/backups/{name}/download, downloaded file name is `formforge-2026-07-24_054710.tar.gz` (NOT the leaked loop-variable 'assets'), success toast 'Migration bundle downloaded' shown.
critical_code_review_comments: backup_routes.py:_upload_roots() now consistently yields (subdir_name, source_path); the create loop (line 116) and restore loop (line 180) both use `_sub`/`_src`/`_dst` (underscore-prefixed) so they can no longer shadow the outer `name` variable. Loop-variable-leak fix verified end-to-end: POST /api/backups returns `formforge-YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS.tar.gz`, tar `tzf` shows all four uploads/{local,pdf,completed,assets}/ subdirs, and a marker file dropped into completed/ survives a full delete→restore cycle.

Settings.jsx:downloadMigrationBundle() correctly awaits POST /backups → grabs `created.data.name` → downloads via blob URL + <a download>. Uses encodeURIComponent(name) so future filename shape changes won't break it. Toast + list-refresh both fire on success.

Settings.jsx has a small structural quirk: BackupRestoreCard is declared OUTSIDE SettingsPage() (after line 255) but PlantDocsTemplateCard is nested INSIDE SettingsPage. Both work at runtime (function decls hoist), but hoisting the nested one out for consistency would be cleaner. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in iter10.
